purpose: SAP Business One Service Layer evidence promotion and session-scoped read design.

connectionRoutes.authentication: POST Login bootstrap yielding executor-private B1SESSION; optional ROUTEID is affinity only
connectionRoutes.notes: Preferred current route. Exact host, port, server instance, company database and principal are tenant-discovered and scope-bound.

connectionRoutes.authentication: same company-scoped Service Layer session contract
connectionRoutes.notes: OData v3 is deprecated from SAP Business One 10.0 FP 2405; no automatic downgrade from v4 on authentication, permission, rate-limit or outage failures.

customerOrPartnerHostedServiceLayer.transport: customer-controlled HTTPS edge or approved private route

sessionReadAuthority.reauthenticationPolicy: required runtime policy: single-flight generation-aware refresh with one bounded reauthentication, then stop; replay the uncommitted page chain from the last committed checkpoint with overlap reconciliation

stableIds: company-scoped journal TransId and line identity
company-scoped document entry and line identifiers
patch.readCapability: OData entity and collection GET/HEAD through exact allowlisted Service Layer resources. $metadata is available per v1/v2 route and reflects company-specific extensions.
patch.writeCapability: Service Layer exposes POST, PATCH, DELETE and business actions, but all mutations, executable actions, SQLQueries and unrestricted navigation remain denied by WFM.
patch.freshnessLatency: Bounded polling and reconciliation; no universal public delta or exactly-once webhook completeness contract is claimed. Session inactivity timeout is configurable and documented as 30 minutes by default.
permissions: dedicated non-superuser SAP Business One integration principal
exact company database and entity authorisations required for approved reads
observed denial of POST/PATCH/DELETE/actions/SQL query surfaces before authentication evidence can advance
customer-approved exact HTTPS Service Layer host and port

paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.pagination: Use provider next links with exact origin/path/version/resource/query authority; default page size is documented as 20 and zero disables pagination, so WFM requires a positive bounded page size and detects gaps/loops/repeats.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.delta: No universal Service Layer delta contract established; use documented per-entity filters only after tenant proof, otherwise bounded snapshots/overlap windows with stable-ID dedupe.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.events: No generic completeness claim; polling and reconciliation remain authoritative.
paginationDeltaEventsFilesQueues.files: Separate customer-controlled route if required; not inferred from Service Layer.

patch.customFields: User-defined fields, tables and objects are reflected in metadata and vary by company database; fingerprint schemas by server instance, company, API version and entity, preserve approved extensions and quarantine breaking or sensitive drift.
patch.regionalApiVersions: Service Layer v2/OData v4 is preferred; v1/OData v3 is compatibility-only. Endpoints are customer deployment specific and may be private/on-premises, partner hosted or distributed. Preserve timezone, locale, currency and unit context from each company database.
patch.rateLimits: No single public universal rate-limit contract verified. Measure in the authorised topology; bound pages, bytes and elapsed time and honour provider/network backpressure without credential storms.
failureModes: ROUTEID loss or load-balancer node change breaking uncommitted pagination continuity
filter/projection/order drift or duplicate query keys in continuation links
partial page chain, duplicate/reordered replay or cursor loop
patch.reconciliation: Bind sessions and checkpoints to the full WFM tenant/connection/origin/company/principal/credential-version/API scope. Never advance on a partial chain. Expiry, affinity loss, route change or failover replays from the last committed checkpoint with overlap and stable-ID dedupe; absence becomes deletion evidence only after a proven complete authoritative snapshot and governed reconciliation.
patch.schemaDrift: Fetch and fingerprint company-scoped v2 $metadata. Additive approved fields retain extension provenance; type, removal, unit, sensitivity or identifier changes quarantine the dataset until reviewed.
patch.retriesReconnect: The built authority decision permits one bounded 401 recovery and forces uncommitted-page replay; repeated 401 and 403 stop while 429/5xx/network failures back off. A production executor still requires a separately implemented and tested single-flight, generation-aware session broker so concurrent or stale failures cannot invalidate a newer session.
patch.evidenceNote: SAP documentation establishes Service Layer OData v3/v4 routes, company/user login, mandatory B1SESSION, optional ROUTEID affinity, session timeout, metadata including company-specific user-defined extensions, entity reads, paging and extensive mutation/action surfaces. No sandbox or customer tenant was authenticated, no effective permissions were observed and no live read round-trip was performed.
securityEvidenceBlockers: Login is a privileged credential bootstrap and successful authentication does not establish read-only authority because the same API exposes mutations and actions.
B1SESSION must remain executor-private; ROUTEID is only a routing hint and cannot establish identity, authorisation, source scope or completeness.
SQLQueries and query-definition administration are excluded from runtime authority even where the provider can constrain them.
Exact company permissions, private-route behavior, timeout/error semantics, next-link forms, limits and schema visibility require an authorised environment.

customerValue: less avoidable overtime and agency labour
less paid idle time on material-blocked work
automationOpportunities: join production orders and inventory movements to WFM skills/availability so material-constrained work is not misdiagnosed as a labour shortage
join employee reference and company/site context to workforce identity while retaining WFM as attendance/payroll authority
reconcile production receipts/issues and journal evidence with WFM labour cost to explain labour per order and good unit

patch.causalOutcomeReadiness: Preserve connection, server instance, company, API version, source key, schema fingerprint and source/effective/observation/ingestion timestamps plus recommendation/action identifiers, baseline/outcome windows and competing material, schedule, machine, quality and finance changes.
patch.nextBuildAction: Implement and test the single-flight generation-aware session broker, then use an authorised SAP Business One test environment to prove exact host/company/principal scope, dedicated read permissions and denied writes/actions/SQLQueries; run real v2 metadata and paginated reads, session expiry/rotation, ROUTEID change, multi-company collision, UDF drift, 401/403/429/5xx recovery and complete-snapshot reconciliation.
